name: agent-sandbox-image-registry-allowlist

controlConfigInputs.name: Allowed image repositories
controlConfigInputs.description: Kubescape checks that all container images in Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate resources are from repositories explicitly allowed in this list.

description: Checks that container images in Agent Sandbox SandboxTemplate resources come from an approved image registry.
remediation: Update the SandboxTemplate container images to use images from an approved registry, or add the registry to the imageRepositoryAllowList configuration.
